prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- home: 89.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Alignment Matrix: Adds a dedicated pet personality and behavior trait selection screen right before certificate generation to help users tailor how their pet acts on desktop. (why: Adoption step has high drop-off (71.1% conversion, mean 1017s), and support notes users being confused about how to interact with or control their pets later.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Key & Email Safeguard Notice: Display an explicit warning and confirmation prompt on the sign-in screen explaining how signing in preserves pet customization across sessions. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again or changing accounts.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Docking & Controls Orientation: Introduces a guided quick-control setup block on the final home intro screen teaching users shortcuts for minimizing, summoning, and moving their pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish conversion is only 73.8%.)
3: [adoption, hint] Pre-Generation Custom Photo Quality Guardrail: Displays dynamic photo composition and lighting tips directly inside the custom photo upload screen to prevent generation glitches. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Late-Stage Sign-In Security Reordering: Moves the sign_in step to after waiting screen so users see their rendered pet in action on desktop before securing their account. (why: Deferring sign-in until after users see value reduces upfront friction and improves initial adoption flow velocity.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Pet Interaction Audio & Sound Toggle: Updates home_intro layout to spotlight companion audio settings and sound feedback toggles. (why: Finish step mean time is 5815s with 73.8% completion; giving clear initial sound/interaction setup clarifies pet behavior.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooter Banner: Displays a notification banner on the waiting screen with direct troubleshooting steps if desktop overlay setup takes longer than expected. (why: 3 emails cited pet not showing on desktop, and home step mean time is 2336s.)
